patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with dramatic, oversized typography as primary visual anchors, often using a dark background for high contrast.
Extreme typographic scale contrast, pairing a very large, condensed display sans-serif for headings with a more neutral, readable sans-serif for body text and small, uppercase labels.
A stark, high-contrast palette dominated by deep blacks and whites, punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon, lime green as a primary accent color for key statements and sections.
The initial full-screen video hero with a serene starry ocean scene transitions dramatically on scroll, revealing a new, static hero section dominated by massive, bold text.
Distinctive full-width sections are used to break up content, each with a unique background treatment ranging from video to solid dark, a vibrant lime green, or a patterned dark texture.

technique_notes: The site employs a dynamic hero transition where an initial full-screen video background with a subtle tagline is replaced by a static, text-heavy hero section as the user scrolls down, creating a sense of reveal and progression. This likely uses css-keyframes for the transition.
Content sections appear to animate into view as they enter the viewport, typically with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye through the content.

Typography is used as a primary design element, with display headings rendered in an exceptionally large, condensed sans-serif font to create immediate visual impact, while body text uses a more standard sans-serif for readability. Small, uppercase text is used for labels and metadata.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed display headings (~5-8x body text) create a bold statement, contrasted with smaller, often uppercase labels and a readable body font.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with almost all elements featuring crisp, 90-degree corners, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of grandeur, while internal content blocks maintain a comfortable reading rhythm.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of typography, where massive, condensed headings dominate the visual hierarchy, creating an immediate and powerful impression. This, combined with a stark black-and-white palette punctuated by a vibrant lime green, gives the site a unique, almost editorial-magazine feel that avoids generic marketing aesthetics.
